description: Call this when someone wants job openings, for example "jobs for a senior finance manager in Denver", "remote director roles" or "who is hiring after my layoff". Searches NextChapter’s own deduplicated board of current professional openings at U.S. employers, newest first; hourly, per-diem and internship roles are excluded. Needs no login. Each job returns the title, company, location, posted date, annual pay when listed, level, how much of that occupation’s work AI is already used for, whether the employer has filed layoff notices in the last 12 months, our page for the job and the employer’s own apply link.

level.description: Seniority: entry, early, mid, senior, manager, director or vp (vp includes executives).

location.description: City or state to match, e.g. "Denver" or "TX".

query.description: Words to match in the job title or company, e.g. "director of finance".

name: search_jobs
title: Search professional jobs
